scope: September 9 event companion · 30 MVP L2 requirements

checks.name: Angular production build
checks.detail: npm run build passed on September 9, 2026. Code review includes the existing working tree.

checks.name: Backend acceptance
checks.detail: dotnet test could not start: global.json requires SDK 10.0.400; installed SDKs are 8.0.425 and 11 preview. No passing result claimed.

checks.name: Event browser acceptance
checks.detail: At audit, e2e contains configuration and mocks, but no event specs or page objects.

checks.name: Real database / load / restore
checks.detail: API test factory uses EF InMemory. No current-scope SQL transaction, 200-viewer load, or isolated restore results established by this audit.

items.title: Manage participants on Countdown
items.note: Roster CRUD and API acceptance cases exist. Finish local admin return to Countdown after advancement, draft/error journeys, and browser acceptance.

items.title: Email entry and raffle confirmation
items.note: Entry, duplicate rejection and replay cases exist. Verify real SQL concurrency, closure races and the complete browser journey.

items.title: Private entry continuity
items.note: Session restore, clear and invalidation code exists. Verify eight-hour expiry and history restoration in Chrome with private draft clearing.

items.title: Countdown, welcome and event information
items.note: Server time sampling and Cornerstone countdown are wired. Verify 90 seconds, clock skew, >24 hours, zero and unavailable time in Chrome.

items.title: Four screens and manual progression
items.note: Four routes and public following exist. Add admin prior-screen navigation, current-screen indicator and Return to live; verify future deep-link restrictions and explicit entry-closing copy.

items.title: Administrator member rearrangement
items.note: Move API and roster dropdown exist, but Team selection lacks drag/drop, equivalent move controls and the unassigned area. Compose released Cornerstone team interactions here.

items.title: Form random teams once
items.note: Formation code and cases exist. Verify controlled shuffle, roster boundaries, concurrent first opening and rollback/restart against SQL.

items.title: RTR cards and team project assignment
items.note: RTR seed, cards and assignment dropdown are present. Verify sharing/clearing assignments and no invented links with browser and real persistence evidence.

items.title: Manage projects on Projects
items.note: CRUD and idempotent API cases exist. Review edit coverage for repository/demo URLs, assigned-team deletion confirmation, draft retention and admin local revisit.

items.title: Optional introduction information
items.note: Optional save is present. Add explicit Skip and verify closure discards unsaved drafts with notice; test that failed profile saves never imply failed raffle entry.

items.title: Raffle pool and public results
items.note: Eligible count and prior winners exist. Add explicit No eligible participants empty feedback; verify renamed winners and removed-person result redaction.

items.title: Fair, durable, single-result draw
items.note: Draw and active-draw cases exist. Verify simultaneous admins, retries, persistence failure and cryptographic selection against real SQL.

items.title: Name cycling and WebGPU celebration
items.note: Published Cornerstone raffle stage receives persisted result and server times. Verify reveal deadline, reconnect, device loss and fallback in Chrome.

items.title: Consume published Cornerstone UI
items.note: Cornerstone 0.2.0 is pinned and production build passes. Complete missing team composition and review every app control and clean npm-only installation.

items.title: Package-owned tokens and styling
items.note: App imports the Cornerstone theme. Review all screen and overlay states against the released token/styling APIs, including remaining team controls.

items.title: Consistent light theme
items.note: Cornerstone theme is imported. Verify both OS color preferences and stale browser preferences across all four screens and dialogs.

items.title: Complete missing UI in Cornerstone first
items.note: Inspect the npm release for required team capabilities. Any missing behavior must be built/tested/released upstream and adopted, then accepted in the app.

items.title: Supported Chrome and capabilities
items.note: Browser scaffolding exists but no event journeys at audit. Add participant/admin acceptance, record Chrome and OS, and verify suspend/resume without WebGPU.

items.title: Responsive four-screen layouts
items.note: Verify populated/empty/error/dialog states at all specified 320–1920 widths, 200% zoom, mobile keyboards and projected raffle reveal.

items.title: Keyboard, semantics and feedback
items.note: Finish team keyboard moves, field-specific errors, focus restoration and one-time announcements. Add full keyboard and contrast acceptance coverage.

items.title: Reduced motion and resilient presentation
items.note: Cornerstone raffle stage is composed. Verify runtime reduced-motion changes, stop-effects control and readable results when all effects fail.

items.title: Shared four-digit administrator login
items.note: Session/idle/revocation API code exists. Login component is only composed on Countdown; make Admin available within every current screen and verify logout returns to live.

items.title: Validate text, emails and links
items.note: Validation exists. Exercise Unicode-scalar length boundaries, invalid URL schemes/credentials, plus tags, trimming and literal text rendering end to end.

items.title: Measure live-event performance
items.note: Run the specified 200-viewer/two-admin baseline with warm-up, ten-minute measurement, 17-entry burst and raw latency/render/drop records; no current evidence established.

items.title: SignalR, persistence and conflicts
items.note: Realtime/version/replay work is active. Complete remaining mutation replay/conflict cases and verify real SignalR delivery/reconnect with SQL; negotiation alone does not prove delivery.

items.title: Diagnostics and recovery
items.note: Runbook/readiness exist. Finish correlated user-visible error references and redacted mutation audit records; execute clean deployment and isolated restore rehearsal.

items.title: Install and update passcode CLI
items.note: Packaging/install-update script and tool project exist. Verify first install/update outside checkout and preservation of the old tool after build/package failure on Windows.

items.title: Explicit database target
items.note: Named targets, identity checks and timeouts exist. Verify Ctrl+C propagation, denied grants, no fallback target and redacted connection errors against SQL.

items.title: Direct database passcode replacement
items.note: Stored procedure and revision support exist. Execute direct SQL while app is stopped/running, including 0042, invalid input, same-value and concurrent replacement.

items.title: Installed CLI passcode replacement
items.note: Command and unknown-result handling exist. Verify installed executable against real API/SQL for both modes, exact exit classes, interruption and interleaved direct/CLI replacement.
